title: Control plane and data plane
summary: ooRexx decides; libxtp moves bytes, as XTP's dev10 architecture states. The control plane (ooRexx, multi-threaded) owns registrations, peerages, key refresh, operating state, admission, firewall requests and receipts through oorexx_logging. The data plane (libxtp) owns carrier sockets, session listeners, byte pumps between sessions and hook descriptors, and fd passing. The pump is native because ooRexx charin on a pipe waits for end of file (tested 2026-11-24).
authority: design (architecture Tom Dyer; written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: The data plane never waits on the control plane: a slow LDAP or a stuck hook leaves established sessions pumping
procedure: Put byte movement in libxtp; put decisions in ooRexx

provenance.claim: ooRexx session API: unguarded read, write, accept
XTP sessions: one context, both directions, per-direction close, one listener socket for all sessions
